title: Atila iAMP COVID-19 Detection Kit - Nasal
author: Opentrons

steps.title: Arrange deck and set pipettes
steps.instruction: Place tube racks on deck slots 1‑7 in numerical order, put the reaction plate on slot 9 (choose non‑skirted or half‑skirted as specified) and a non‑skirted plate on slot 8; configure the P20 single‑ and multi‑channel pipettes on the left or right mounts as indicated; the pipette will access each tube rack by column (A1, B1, C1, A2, B2, C2 …).

substeps.instruction: Load tube racks into slots 1‑7 sequentially.
Place the reaction plate on slot 9 (non‑skirted or half‑skirted as chosen).
Place a non‑skirted plate on slot 8 (always non‑skirted).
Mount the P20 single‑channel and multi‑channel pipettes on the designated left/right mounts.
Confirm the pipette will address tube racks column‑wise (A1, B1, C1, A2, …).

steps.title: Dispense SBM to reaction plate
steps.instruction: Add Sample Buffer Mix (SBM) to the reaction plate wells up to the number of samples specified, following the dispensing pattern for the chosen sample count.

substeps.instruction: If running a full plate (94 samples): use the multi‑channel pipette to dispense SBM into the first 11 columns, then use the single‑channel pipette to dispense SBM into the first 6 wells of column 12.

If running fewer than 94 samples (e.g., 12 samples): use the multi‑channel pipette to dispense SBM into all wells of column 1, then use the single‑channel pipette to dispense SBM into the first four wells of column 2, and finally add extra SBM to wells G12 and H12 as needed.
Place any additional SBM required for the run in wells 1‑7 depending on the total number of samples.

steps.title: Add samples and mix
steps.instruction: Transfer each sample into its designated well and mix the sample with SBM three times.

steps.title: Incubate plate 15 minutes
steps.instruction: Incubate the reaction plate at the prescribed temperature for 15 minutes.

steps.title: Dispense mastermix to reaction plate
steps.instruction: Add mastermix to the reaction plate wells up to the number of samples specified, using the appropriate pipette configuration.

substeps.instruction: If running a full plate (94 samples): use the multi‑channel pipette to dispense mastermix into all 96 wells.

If running fewer than 94 samples: follow the same column pattern used for SBM (e.g., multi‑channel for column 1, single‑channel for remaining wells) and place any extra mastermix in wells 1‑7 as required.

steps.title: Add controls to G12 and H12
steps.instruction: Add the designated positive and negative controls to wells G12 and H12 of the reaction plate.
